description: Build a CAN-SPAM and GDPR compliant opt-out footer in plain text and HTML, with a checklist saying which compliance requirements the details given actually satisfy. A footer with no postal address is the usual failure.

address.description: Physical postal address. Required by CAN-SPAM.

company.description: Sender name, as it should appear.

style.description: How someone opts out. Defaults to reply.

unsubUrl.description: Unsubscribe link, for the link and both styles.

name: generate_unsubscribe
title: CAN-SPAM opt-out footer
